$comment: Endpoints that use the card.binary buffer as an intermediary for binary data. These requests are JSON-only — no raw bytes are streamed directly. The host manages the buffer via card.binary.put/get. 'direction' is relative to the host and the buffer: 'send' = host fills buffer before this request (Notecard reads from it), 'receive' = Notecard fills buffer after this request (host reads via card.binary.get). 'when' specifies the request field condition under which binary buffer involvement applies.
